description: Set the absolute quantity for a buy-list card+finish (not a delta). A quantity of 0 removes the row. Use add_buy_list to increment instead. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

isFoil.description: Whether this is the foil variant. Foil and non-foil are separate rows. Defaults to false.

quantity.description: Absolute quantity to set. 0 removes the row.

name: update_buy_list
